name: pocketdiff
description: Turn a git diff into a self-contained, mobile- and tablet-friendly HTML file for reviewing code on the go.

scripts.bundle: esbuild bin/cli.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node16 --legal-comments=none --banner:js="// GENERATED by 'npm run bundle' from bin/cli.js + src/* — do not edit by hand." --outfile=.claude/skills/pocketdiff/cli.cjs
